fancy.unsupported_reason: FANcY compares packet counters; pure bandwidth throttling without packet loss is outside this replay contract.
fancy.source_parameter: The paper evaluates dedicated counters at a 50 ms exchange frequency and reports about 70 ms average detection for sufficiently active entries. The 20 ms residual is an average calibration term, not an exact per-event session-close measurement.

trumpet.source_parameter: The paper evaluates fine-grained trigger predicates in 10 ms intervals and reports about 0.75 ms from first satisfaction to the final poll reply for 256 simultaneous events; both values are projections here, not SimAI measurements.

netbouncer.unsupported_reason: The published probe-loss model does not directly detect loss-free bandwidth throttling.
netbouncer.source_parameter: The production design chooses a 5 minute probe epoch; reported processing time is 30.0/37.3/56.0 seconds min/mean/max.

rdma_reference.source_parameter: Ten seconds is the deliberately explicit baseline assumption supplied by the project requirements, not a measurement from this simulator.

nccl_reference.source_parameter: A representative default NCCL IB timeout/retry combination can expose a network error after roughly 30 seconds; it is not simulated by the current frontend.

mp_rdma.source_parameter: The paper reports less than one second to fully utilize a restored path, not failure-to-surviving-port cutover latency.

flor.source_parameter: The paper reports about 60 us to switch to a pre-connected backup QP versus about 5 ms to reconnect a QP; failure-to-error-WC time is not supplied by this projection.

shift.source_parameter: The paper measures 2.30 ms mean fallback from polling an error WC to full backup-RNIC traffic, not physical failure to error WC.

optcc.source_parameter: The paper's SimAI setup reports 2-6% overhead versus fault-free NCCL for evaluated failures. This benchmark maps one degraded GPU/NIC link to pooled server capacity and evaluates Theorem 13, but does not execute the four-stage flow schedule.

recover.source_parameter: The executable model checks epoch-tagged abort/rewind/redo semantics only; it is not the paper's MPI/ULFM implementation or a timing reproduction.
